feeds.title: Andy Naselli Thoughts on Theology
feeds.description: The articles on my website are my 'thoughts on theology' that overflow from my vocation. I add new content about once each week and typically highlight resources I find helpful and that fellow Christians may also find helpful. Blog by Andy Naselli.

feeds.title: Church Life Journal
feeds.description: Church Life Journal is published by the McGrath Institute for Church Life at the University of Notre Dame. The McGrath Institute for Church Life partners with Catholic dioceses, parishes and schools to address pastoral challenges with theological depth and rigor.

feeds.title: Monergism
feeds.description: Monergism.com is a free, comprehensive online theological library comprised of Reformed Christian resources designed to bring glory to Jesus Christ alone. The directory consists of original and aggregated content from around the world emphasizing the good news that salvation is God's free gift for guilty sinners, not a reward for the righteous.

feeds.title: Patheos
feeds.description: This blog hopes to play a role in spurring discussion and sharing resources so that the global church would further develop a missiological theology and a theological missiology. We cannot afford to separate missiology and theology. Missiology separated from theology is little more than anthropology and sociology. Theology distinguished from missiology is abstraction.

feeds.title: Patheos
feeds.description: Paperback Theology is a place to talk about religion, politics (especially politics), art, culture, spirituality, and the church. This blog exists for those of us who are not the world's leading expert on anything, and yet we find that we are insatiably inquisitive about nearly everything on the planet, particularly from the perspective of its relationship to God.

feeds.title: Church Grammar
feeds.description: The Church Grammar podcast engages theology and the church in a fresh way, centered on wide-ranging conversations with scholars and Bible teachers.

feeds.title: The Wabash Center Blog
feeds.description: Engage with our bloggers on a wide range of topics, and critical reflection on teaching religion and theology. The Wabash Center's constituency are faculty in the fields of theology and religion. We support faculty reflecting upon teaching and the teaching life when employed in theological education, colleges and universities in North America.

feeds.title: Douglas Wilson Blog
feeds.description: The point of Blog & Mablog is pretty broad — 'All of Christ for all of life.' In order to make that happen, we need 'theology that bites back.'

feeds.title: Canon Fodder
feeds.description: Michael J. Kruger is the President and Samuel C. Patterson Professor of New Testament at Reformed Theological Seminary in Charlotte. Exploring the origins of the New Testament canon and other biblical and theological issues.

feeds.title: Exegesis and Theology
feeds.description: The Blog of Brian Collins who completed his Ph.D. in theology at Bob Jones University's Seminary and Graduate School of Religion in 2011. He is a Bible Integration specialist at BJU Press in Greenville, SC.

feeds.title: Catholic Moral Theology
feeds.description: Catholic moral theologians blogging toward deeper friendship, wisdom, and discipleship, for the sake of the kingdom of God. RTs mean interest, not endorsement.

feeds.title: Experimental Theology
feeds.description: You are not big enough to accuse the whole age effectively, but let us say you are in dissent. You are in no position to issue commands, but you can speak words of hope. Shall this be the substance of your message? Be human in this most inhuman of ages; guard the image of man for it is the image of God.

feeds.title: P.OST
feeds.description: My overriding theological interest at the moment is in how we retell the biblical story as we negotiate the difficult transition from the centre to the margins of our culture following the collapse of Western Christendom. Working on a narrative-historical theology for the church after Christendom.

feeds.title: Art & Theology
feeds.description: Created by Victoria Emily Jones, ART & THEOLOGY aims to bring these two disciplines into conversation with each other for the spiritual nourishment of the church. Revitalizing the Christian imagination through painting, poetry, music, and more.

feeds.title: ancientchurchorders
feeds.description: A blog on the ancient church orders.

feeds.title: ReasonableTheology.org
feeds.description: Reasonable Theology seeks to explain and defend the theology, worldview, and doctrine of the Christian faith.

feeds.title: Knucklehead Theology
feeds.description: The rantings and ravings, teaching and occasional preaching of a Christian who makes his living rebuilding and modifying vintage Harley Davidsons.

feeds.title: Political Theology Today
feeds.description: A forum for interdisciplinary and interreligious dialogue. The blog for the journal Political Theology, commenting on the intersection between religion, politics and culture.

feeds.title: Holding Pattern
feeds.description: Peter Holding has worked as a lawyer and as a political adviser to Victorian Premiers Steve Bracks and John Brumby. He is a former member of the ALP National Policy Committee. This blog contains articles and essays written by Peter over the years. Some are written to be accessible to teenagers- others more for adults.

feeds.title: Triablogue
feeds.description: Serious Trinitarian Theology. And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he doth judge and make war.

feeds.title: Right Reason
feeds.description: The New Zealand based blog and podcast that looks at theology, philosophy, biblical studies and social issues from a Christian point of view.

feeds.title: Art of Holiness Blog
feeds.description: The art of living out a Wesleyan theology that is Orthodox, practical and joyful.

feeds.title: Eclectic Orthodoxy
feeds.description: A theological blog devoted to the Gospel of Jesus Christ, the Church Fathers, and the Orthodox faith.

feeds.title: Christian Theology
feeds.description: A team Blog on traditional Christian thought in the midst of an innovative cultural mood. These bloggers come together to discuss Christian theology.

feeds.title: Women in Theology - WIT
feeds.description: WIT is a shared blog by women trained in the academic disciplines of theology who write from a Christian ecumenical and often feminist perspective.

feeds.title: Summit Life with J.D. Greear
feeds.description: The gospel of Jesus Christ is the source of our life, a deep well of grace that transforms us and propels us into the world. Join Pastor J.D. Greear each weekday to learn how the gospel can bring new life in you and through you.

feeds.title: Theology of the Body
feeds.description: The Theology of the Body Institute offers a head and heart immersion in Pope St. John Paul II's Theology of the Body. The mission of Theology of the Body Institute is to educate and train men and women to understand, live and promote the Theology of the Body.

feeds.title: Truth Is The Word
feeds.description: TruthIstheWord.com is currently a multimedia library containing the products of three decades of pastoral and academic life or Dr. Chris Peppler. The material ranges from scholarly papers to short cameos of church life from a pastors perspective. The site is a repository of his life-work to date, bringing important Christian truths to the online community and providing a platform for those who are searching for The Truth.

feeds.title: Krista Bontrager Blog
feeds.description: Access the teachings of theologian and lay minister, Krista Bontrager. Mission to provide practical Bible teaching and equip Christians to be ministers of reconciliation.

feeds.title: FaithonView
feeds.description: We cover a lot of subjects here on Faith on View. But, as we have worked to define ourselves over the years we realized that there is a simple commonality to what we do. We help Christians live and love in the tension of faith. This messy beautiful life of faith that Christians walk often requires us to lean into existential questions which challenge us. If we are living a life of faith there is always a tension between the principles that guide us and our lived experience. We are here to share our walks and struggles in this life as we seek to live and love faithfully.

feeds.title: Theology That Matters
feeds.description: A blog by Timothy J. Hammons. God gives us all gifts, some spiritual, some practical. I feel compelled to write about things from a Christian world perspective.

feeds.title: Liberation Theology Lutheran
feeds.description: I'm a lifelong Lutheran, and although I'm aware of some of the problems with Liberation Theology, it has spoken to me for much of my adolescent and adult life. All of the thoughts on this blog are mine, and I don't intend to speak for any other Lutherans or Liberation Theologians.

feeds.title: Quantum Theology
feeds.description: Roman Catholic wife, mother, writer and teacher blogs about life, laundry, prayer and God. Blog by Michelle Francl-Donnay.

feeds.title: Classic Theology New
feeds.description: This blog is an attempt to provide some of the insights that I have come to value as I sift theology, sometimes the same theology over and over. And occasionally I stumble across one of those beautiful little theological insights that brings clarity to so much more. I hope you enjoy the blog.

feeds.title: Christian Theist In A Postmodern World Blog
feeds.description: Isaias D'Oleo is an ordained minister in the Reformed Church in America and a doctoral student specializing in philosophical theology at the Calvin Theological Seminary. His research interests include science-religion dialogue, philosophy of mind, Christian metaphysics and analytical theology. This blog is to promote critical reflection on modern issues in theology.

feeds.title: Ecclesial Theology
feeds.description: Doing theology in, with, and for the church--in the midst of its divisions, and toward its visible unity in one eucharistic fellowship.

feeds.title: The Armchair Theologian
feeds.description: The armchair theologian shares some thoughts that touch upon the real issues of life. I hope you are blessed!

feeds.title: Apostolic Theology
feeds.description: Apostolic Theology is a blog that's vaguely about Apostolic theology.

feeds.description: The Center for Pastor Theologians (CPT) is an organization dedicated to assisting pastor in the study and production of biblical and theological scholarship for the ecclesial renewal of orthodox theology, for the renewal of the local church.

feeds.title: Monergism Blog
feeds.description: This blog is a free directory of theology, whose main goal is to promote salvation by Christ ALONE. That salvation is a gift of Christ for guilty sinners not a reward for the righteous.

feeds.title: Patheos
feeds.description: Kyle Roberts (Ph.D.) is Schilling Professor of Public Theology and the Church and Economic Life at United Theological Seminary of the Twin Cities. Find Kyle Roberts' reflections on public and missional concerns.

Based in Fort Worth, its thought-provoking content fosters engaging conversations on theology, offering insights and occasional humour.

feeds.title: The Diagonal Way
feeds.description: Theological reflections on creation's holy journey into the life of its holy Creator.

feeds.title: Dr. Michael Heiser
feeds.description: What does the Bible really say about the unseen world—unfiltered by tradition or theological presuppositions. Michael Heiser discusses biblical theology in an ancient context.

feeds.title: Foster's Theological Reflections
feeds.description: Sporadic theological and historical musings by Edgar Foster (Ph.D. in Theology and Religious Studies and one of Jehovah's Witnesses).

feeds.title: Thoughts Theological
feeds.description: Thoughts Theological from the pen of Terrance L. Tiessen. I have a faith that seeks understanding. I find that writing is a helpful process toward clarifying my thoughts and moving me forward in my understanding. Find some of my writings here.

feeds.title: Helm's Deep
feeds.description: Paul Helm is a Professor of History & Philosophy of Religion from King's College, London. Find post on Philosophical Theology by Paul Helm on his blog

feeds.title: AI Theology Blog
feeds.description: AI theology is a blog that seeks to do theology in a world where Artificial Intelligence is a reality. Exploring the intersection between Christianity and data analytics.

feeds.title: The Sacred Page
feeds.description: A Blog about the Bible and Catholic Theology by Michael Barber, John Bergsma, Brant Pitre, and John Kincaid. The study of the sacred page is, as it were, the soul of sacred theology.

feeds.title: Detroit Baptist Theological Seminary Blog
feeds.description: Detroit Baptist Theological Seminary is committed to glorifying God by training men to fulfill the Great Commission, read posts from the Seminary on their blog. feeds.title: Daily Theology
feeds.description: DailyTheology.org brings the study and practice of theology into conversation with daily life.

feeds.title: OMG Center for Theological Conversation Blog
feeds.description: Anna is a freelance theologian. Be it for individuals, couples, small or large groups, Anna provides a place where people can wonder about God. Whether in her OMG study, in congregational settings, in large group presentations, or in her writing, Anna seeks to invite people to ask their questions about God, theology, and how it matters.

feeds.title: The Centre for Theology & Community Blog
feeds.description: Equipping churches to transform their communities through community organising, reflection & prayer - and helping them use their resources for this mission.

feeds.title: Grace Theology Press Blog
feeds.description: Birthed from a desire to provide engaging and relevant theological resources, Grace Theology Press is the academic imprint of Grace School of Theology. Grace Theology Press holds fast to the absolute truth of God's Word.

feeds.title: Bible and Theology Blog
feeds.description: Resources to advance Christian thinking and living.

feeds.title: Rightly Dividing the Word of Truth

Victor Kash-Umoru is a writer, author and blogger. Victor is an inspired teacher who enjoys engaging in theological discussions about God, His Christ and His Creation.

feeds.title: Theological Theology
feeds.description: It's all about the God who has made himself known in Jesus Christ.

feeds.description: Transverse (adj. 'situated, arranged, or acting in a crosswise manner') Markings (n. 'observations') provides one person's theological commentary on matters divine and human. feeds.title: Theology Least Dangerous Blog
feeds.description: Posts about Theology written by Joel Nolette and Rob Barthelmess

feeds.description: Serving the joyful cultivation of the theological craft for the life of the church: inquiring honestly, deliberating wisely, acting faithfully. Visit the Theology Forum to find a discussion on the cultivation of theology.

feeds.title: Theological Scribbles

feeds.title: Strawberry-Rhubarb Theology

feeds.title: Rachel Held Evans Blog
feeds.description: Rachel Held Evans is a blogger, speaker, author of 'Searching for Sunday', 'A Year of Biblical Womanhood', and 'Faith Unraveled. She writes about faith, doubt and life in the Bible Belt.

feeds.title: Faith and Theology
feeds.description: A blog for theological scholarship and contemporary theological reflection. By Ben Myers.

feeds.title: The Theological Anthropology Blog
feeds.description: The Theological Anthropology Blog is committed to hosting conversations at the intersection of theology and daily life. We believe that the relationship between seemingly abstract theological doctrines and concrete life experiences often remains unclear, and we are convinced that both need each other.

feeds.title: The Christian Century

feeds.title: ging Theologically Blog

feeds.title: Knox Theological Seminary Blog
